title: Wayfare Pro Programme Terms, Part 2: The Quarterly Status Evaluation
content:
**2.1 Evaluation day and basis.** Under **Driver Earnings and Wayfare Pro**, on the first day of each calendar quarter the driver's Wayfare Pro status for the new quarter is set from the quarter just ended: the highest status whose entry gate is met by that quarter's points, the driver's current rating, cancellation rate and acceptance rate. The entry gates are those of the Wayfare Pro status schedule.

**2.2 Status protection.** A driver drops at most 1 level (the status protection limit of the status schedule) at one evaluation, even when the quarter's results meet only a lower gate.

**2.3 Reset.** The quarter's points are then reset to zero; points never carry over and status is never changed mid-quarter, whatever the driver's results so far.

**2.4 Retired clause.** The former clause under which status benefits (instant cashout fees and free cashouts) followed the status recorded on the account for the current quarter is no longer in force as a clause of this evaluation; the benefits that turn on Wayfare Pro status are governed by the current bases of the product that name it.

## How an evaluation resolves

| Step of the evaluation | What it reads |
|---|---|
| Find the highest gate met | The quarter just ended: its Pro points; the driver's current rating, cancellation rate and acceptance rate |
| Apply status protection | The status held in the quarter just ended |
| Reset the quarter's points | Points go to zero after the evaluation |

## Hypothetical cases

| Status in the quarter just ended | Highest gate met by that quarter | Status for the new quarter |
|---|---|---|
| Wayfare Pro Silver | Platinum gate | Wayfare Pro Platinum |
| Wayfare Pro Gold | Gold gate | Wayfare Pro Gold |
| Wayfare Pro Platinum | Silver gate | Wayfare Pro Gold (drop limited to one level) |
| Wayfare Pro Diamond Elite | Blue gate | Wayfare Pro Diamond (drop limited to one level) |

**Mid-quarter results.** A driver who, part way through a quarter, already has enough points for a higher gate keeps the current status until the first day of the next quarter.

superseded_clauses: Status benefits (instant cashout fees and free cashouts) follow the status recorded on the account for the current quarter.
